name: @zjinh/vue-virtual-tree
description: A virtual tree component for Vue 2.7 and Vue 3
author: zjinh

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build.mjs && tsdown && tsc -p tsconfig.declarations.json && node scripts/finalize-build.mjs
scripts.dev:vue2: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @zjinh/vue-virtual-tree-demo-vue2 run dev
scripts.dev:vue3: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @zjinh/vue-virtual-tree-demo-vue3 run dev
scripts.typecheck:demos: pnpm --filter @zjinh/vue-virtual-tree-demo-vue2 run typecheck && pnpm --filter @zjinh/vue-virtual-tree-demo-vue3 run typecheck
scripts.build:demos: pnpm --filter @zjinh/vue-virtual-tree-demo-vue2 run build && pnpm --filter @zjinh/vue-virtual-tree-demo-vue3 run build
scripts.test:demos:check: pnpm run test:demos:unit && pnpm run typecheck:demos && pnpm run build:demos
scripts.test:demos: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:demos:check
scripts.test: pnpm run test:package && pnpm run test:model && pnpm run test:components && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:sfc && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:artifacts && pnpm run test:types && pnpm run test:demos:check
scripts.test:components: pnpm run test:component:vue2 && pnpm run test:component:vue3
scripts.prepack: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:artifacts
scripts.release:check: pnpm run test:package && pnpm run test:model && pnpm run test:components && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:sfc && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:artifacts && pnpm run test:types && pnpm run test:demos:check && publint
scripts.publish:check: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run pack:release && pnpm run test:tarball && pnpm run test:attw
scripts.ci:check: pnpm run publish:check && pnpm run test:pages
